# Open-Assistant

Open Assistant is a chatbot that can answer questions and provide information.

## Getting Started

These instructions will get you a copy of the project up and running on your local machine for development and testing purposes.

### Prerequisites

What things you need to install the software and how to install them

```
Open Assistant uses Python 3.7 and has been tested with the following Python versions:

3.7.10
3.8.10
3.9.6
3.10.2

You will need a Python development environment installed on your computer. You can download Python from the official website: https://www.python.org/downloads/

You will also need the following libraries:

BeautifulSoup4
PyYAML
Markdown

You can install these libraries using pip:

pip install beautifulsoup4 pyyaml markdown

You can install Open Assistant using the following command:

python3 -m openassistant.cli

This will install the Open Assistant command line interface and set up a development environment for you to write and test your chatbot.

```

### Usage

A summary of the commands available

```
usage: openassistant [--version]

Open Assistant chatbot

optional arguments:
  --version, -v = False, default False,
    show program command line flags (--version)
```

### Testing

A summary of the commands available

```
usage: openassistant test [--version]

Open Assistant chatbot

optional arguments:
  --version, -v = False, default False,
    show program command line flags (--version)
```

# Open-Assistant

[Open Assistant](https://open-assistant.io) is an open-source language assistant. It is a project of the [Open Assistant Foundation](https://open-assistant.io/foundation).

## Introduction

Open Assistant is a language assistant that aims to provide users with natural language responses to a wide range of tasks. It is designed to be accessible, easy to use, and free from proprietary or proprietary-like restrictions.

## Getting Started

You can get started with Open Assistant by following these steps:

1. [Install Open Assistant](https://open-assistant.io/install).
2. [Create a new Open Assistant project](https://open-assistant.io/projects/new).
3. [Choose a language](https://open-assistant.io/languages) to start with.
4. [Add a prompt](https://open-assistant.io/docs/guides/prompts/index.html) and answer it.
5. [Add an assistant](https://open-assistant.io/docs/guides/creating-assistant/index.html) to your project.
6. [Configure the assistant](https://open-assistant.io/docs/guides/creating-assistant/configuration.html) to your liking.
7. [Publish your project](https://open-assistant.io/docs/guides/publishing-projects/publishing-projects.html) to the internet.

## Contributing

Open Assistant is an open-source project, and contributions are always welcome. You can find more information about how to contribute on the [Contributing page](https://open-assistant.io/docs/contributing/index.html).
